items.title: Email Campaign · : Referral Push (30-60 Day Cohort)
items.preview:
**1. Campaign name + audience**
"The Quiet Ask". Referral Push · **30 recipients** (30-60 day post-install, satisfied)
**2. Subject line + alternates** (60 char max)
- Primary: `A question worth $500`
- Alt A (curiosity): `The thing our best clients do at 45 days`
- Alt B (pain): `Know someone still drinking the neighborhood water?`
- Alt C (authority): `Why we don't advertise much`
- Alt D (specific): `$500 per neighbor. Here's how it works.`
**3. Preview text** (90 char max)
`No pressure. Just the referral math, laid out plainly, in case you know someone.`
**4. Email body**
Hi Jason,
It's been about a month since we installed your Ironmax and Ferroluxe setup in Disputanta. By now the water should just feel like part of the house: quiet, clean, no thinking about it.
That's usually when a name or two comes to mind. A neighbor on the same well. A family member who complains about their water every time you visit.
Here's how our referral program works, plainly:
- Someone you send us books a free water assessment but doesn't move forward: you get a $50 gift card.
- They become a client: you get $500 cash. Your 6th through 9th referral in a year is $750 each, and 10 or more is $1,000 each.
No pushing on your end. Just pass along a name, or forward this email, and we handle the rest.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
**5. Send timing:** Tuesday, 10:00 AM ET (post-inbox-clear, pre-lunch; best B2C-adjacent open window)
**6. Expected performance:**
- Open: 48-55% (small, warm, recently-serviced list; well above your 42.1% baseline because these are freshly happy customers and the name is personalized)
- Click: 3-6% (your 0.28% baseline reflects tired "Client App" blasts to cold contacts; a warm cohort with a cash number and a forward-CTA converts far higher)
- Conversion: 2-4 booked referral consults from 30 sends is realistic; even 1 close returns $500 vs. near-zero send cost
**7. Source justification:** Draws from Jobber "Referral push candidates (30-60 days post-install)" trigger list and the REFERRAL BONUS STRUCTURE. Uses the exact "free water assessment" phrase (Rule 3a) and pushes referrals, not reviews (Rule 3).
---

items.title: Email Campaign · : Concierge "Is It Worth It" (Year 1.5 Cohort)
items.preview:
**1. Campaign name + audience**
"The Year 1.5 Question". Concierge Upsell · **100 recipients** (13-24 mo post-install, not on Concierge; already past their year-1 service, so Rule 1 is satisfied)
**2. Subject line + alternates** (60 char max)
- Primary: `Is Concierge worth it for you? The math.`
- Alt A (curiosity): `The question we get asked at 18 months`
- Alt B (pain): `Tired of tracking your own filter swaps?`
- Alt C (authority): `What $99 a month actually covers`
- Alt D (specific): `Annual service, filter swaps, parts. One plan.`
**3. Preview text** (90 char max)
`No hard sell. Just the honest breakdown so you can decide for yourself.`
**4. Email body**
Hi Albert,
Your Re-Ionator Pro and RO system in Chantilly is past its first year now, which means you've been through one annual service and you know how we work.
Around this point, we get one question a lot: "Is this Concierge thing actually worth it for me?"
Here's the honest math. Concierge is $99 a month and covers:
- Your annual service (already something you'd schedule anyway)
- Filter swaps, handled on our calendar, not yours
- Priority phone support
- Parts coverage on your standard install components
If you're the type who'd rather never think about a filter date again, it tends to pay for itself in convenience alone. If you prefer pay-as-you-go, that's completely fine too. No pressure either way.
Reply "tell me more" and I'll send your specific breakdown.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
**5. Send timing:** Thursday, 9:30 AM ET (avoids Tuesday overlap with Proposal 1; mid-week decision-friendly window)
**6. Expected performance:**
- Open: 40-46% (larger, slightly cooler list than the referral cohort, but all are past year-1 and have a service relationship; near baseline)
- Click/reply: 1-3% (the "reply to opt in" CTA lowers friction vs. a click-through; even a soft 2% is ~2 recurring $99/mo subscriptions = ~$2,376/yr)
- Conversion: 1-3 Concierge signups realistic from 100 warm, trust-established recipients
**7. Source justification:** Draws from Jobber "Concierge upsell candidates (13-24 months)" trigger list and CONCIERGE UPSELL CONTEXT (uses the "is this worth it at year 1.5, here's the math" framing verbatim in spirit). Complies with Rule 1 (all recipients past 12 months) and Rule 2 (names "Re-Ionator Pro" rather than "your ClearWave").
---
**Why these two:** The referral cohort is your highest-ROI warm audience this week (freshly satisfied, cash incentive, tiny list = high deliverability). The Concierge cohort is your largest qualified recurring-revenue play that clears the 12-month floor. I intentionally skipped the 1-year annual-service and cold-lead campaigns this week to avoid inbox fatigue on overlapping segments; flag me if you want the 1,000-person cold re-engagement drafted next.

---
